source_all_pass_gate: The exact 2025-01-13 dated public workbook returns HTTP 200 without redirect, credential or retry and is no larger than 8 MiB.
The first legacy-XLS sheet contains exactly the frozen eight-field schema and parseable unique ascending daily dates with finite nonnegative GPRD values.
Every calendar day from 2018-01-01 through 2024-12-31 is present exactly once without repair, imputation or alternate vintage substitution.
Two create-only source executions produce byte-identical bundle and normalized-gzip hashes.

all_pass_predictive_gates: Design and Validation each contain at least 50 high-state next-day outcomes and at least 50 low-state next-day outcomes.
High-state mean next-day BTC open-to-open return exceeds low-state mean in both Design and Validation.
Validation high-state downside semideviation is no worse than low-state downside semideviation.
High-minus-low annual mean next-day return is positive in at least three of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024.
No single positive annual high-minus-low contribution supplies more than 60 percent of total positive annual contribution.

stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before factor computation on any transport, redirect, workbook, field, date, duplicate, missing-day, nonfinite-value, coverage, vintage or determinism failure.
Do not use the latest workbook, another vintage, monthly data, AI-GPR, a paid or alternate provider, imputation, repair or a shorter window.

After source value access, do not change the percentile, lookback, strict direction, seven-day availability lag, next-open mapping, window, gate, cost or comparator and do not add equity, VIX, oil, gold, EPU or named-conflict interactions.
If any frozen predictive gate fails, close the exact family before matched-capital economics and keep OOS sealed.
scope_note: Frozen exact dated free GPR source and downstream predictive preregistration before any GPR cell or BTC outcome access.
